mina: quick brain-dump — i want to propose a delta-based snapshot strategy for runtime hints to reduce edge churn. main idea: ship small signed deltas (add/remove rules) instead of full snapshots for minor policy tweaks.
carlos: ok but deltas bite us if apply order or missing base. how do you verify integrity?
mina: payload: {base_hash, seq_id, delta_ops[], signer_id}. runtime verifies base_hash matches cached base. if mismatch, runtime requests full snapshot and enters conservative mode (no filters). we sign deltas with key rotation via KMS.
tara: concern: races during rollout — edges applying deltas at different paces could cause inconsistent admits. what's our recovery?
mina: add two safety mechanisms: 1) conservative TTL window after any delta apply where runtime expands its candidate set (fail-open bias) 2) a periodic full-snapshot checksum reconcile (default every 5m). if reconcile fails -> auto-fetch full snapshot.
carlos: metrics we should track?
mina: delta_apply_rate, delta_apply_failures, fallback_to_full_count, conservative_window_triggered, false_filter_incidents (runtime filtered route that compiler later deems required).
tara: rollout plan?
mina: shadow deltas for 7 days (emit what-would-have-filtered), then canary 1% of edges apply deltas, monitor metrics for 48h, then ramp. kill-switch will disable delta apply entirely and force full-snapshot fetch.
ops-bot: infra-check: require 100% trace sampling for canary, create ticket INFRA-5011.
carlos: one more: provide an operator endpoint to replay deltas against a given base_hash in a simulator before pushing. saves mistakes.
mina: good call — include /internal/sim/apply_delta API and make it part of CI checks.
tara: and add a `max_delta_ops` limit to avoid huge deltas that approximate full snapshots. maybe 100 ops default.
mina: agreed. i'll draft the RFC with example delta proto, safety heuristics, metrics dashboard mockups, and staged rollout. aiming for arch sync next Friday.
carlos: thanks — looks solid.
mina: TL;DR config snippet i'll include:
``
runtime.hints.delta_apply_enabled = true
runtime.hints.delta_max_ops = 100
runtime.hints.reconcile_interval = "5m"
runtime.hints.conservative_window_ms = 1000
``
mina: ok ending thread, will share RFC link when ready.
